meta.title: A vendor reading get_audience does not see competitors
gaps: the plan has the vendor send GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_audience, but the supplier app may not call GET /event_groups/:id/get_audience (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the request that lists the event's vendors, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
